dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: ...Oh, you're just a traveler. I was convinced that you were a hilichurl...

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: Aha, well! Ever heard of a little something called "manliness"?

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: That fellow Jack from the Adventurers' Guild, he knows all about it. Says that if you defeat ten thousand hilichurls, then everyone suddenly sees you as Mr. Manly, and so on.

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: Sooooo... I am currently getting ready to prove, once and for all, that I am the manliest man of the lot!

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! I'm taking my time over this. Don't want to rush into it and make a fool of myself now, do I?

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: Hilichurls are the most terrifying of creatures. You don't go up against a hilichurl without doing some serious preparation in advance!

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: You know, filing your nails, styling your bangs...

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: The road to manliness is long and hard...
